title: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!

entities.name: Kynaios
entities.description: A Theran human who, with Tiro, led the people against the immortal archon Agnomakhos and became a guardian of the polis of Meletis.

entities.name: Tiro
entities.description: A Theran human bound to Kynaios by love for him and for freedom, who helped defeat Agnomakhos and guards Meletis.

entities.name: Agnomakhos
entities.description: An immortal archon and tyrant of antiquity whose empire was ended by Kynaios and Tiro.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: A necro-alchemist of Nephalia who builds monsters from animated dead tissue and studies the horror they inspire.

entities.name: Kraum
entities.description: Ludevic's flying, multi-headed creation, heralded by static pops and cackling, regularly seen over Selhoff.

entities.name: Sidar Kondo
entities.description: A knight and horseman from Jamuraa on Dominaria who led in the Mirage War and was killed by his own son Vuel.

entities.name: Vuel
entities.description: Sidar Kondo's blood son, consumed by envy and bitterness, who killed him.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: A refugee adopted by Sidar Kondo with a heroic destiny.

entities.name: Yidris
entities.description: A Grixis ogre mage afflicted by unstable mutations who was driven into the Maelstrom, which stabilized him as a conduit of chaos.

entities.name: Kydele
entities.description: The primary oracle of Kruphix who has seen truths about the gods and Theros's place in the Multiverse.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: Theros's enigmatic god of horizons and mysteries.

entities.name: Thrasios
entities.description: A triton of Meletis who believes he has Thassa's blessing and pilgrimages to the ocean's depths, claiming to have visited Olantin.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: Theros's god of the sea.

entities.name: Vial Smasher the Fierce
entities.description: A brash goblin of the Kolaghan clan on Tarkir who handles and smashes vials of dragonfire.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who in another timeline considered Vial Smasher a clan-mate and friend.

entities.name: Saskia
entities.description: The sole survivor of a massacre of her village who built a monument for ten years and then led a host to wage war on her enemies.

entities.name: Tymna the Weaver
entities.description: A blind Theran mortal who mastered the magic of the Fates after a career as one of the Battlewise of Meletis.

entities.name: Ravos
entities.description: An oracle of Athreos who guides the dead to the Underworld to see his dead lover yearly while secretly defying the god.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: The Theran god of passage.

entities.name: Tana
entities.description: An elf abandoned as a child and raised by fungal saprolings, who now hunts trespassers to feed them.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: A formerly Mirran angel captured and compleated by the praetors, marking Phyrexia's final victory over Mirrodin.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who honored Atraxa with compleation.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who declined to contribute to Atraxa's compleation.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who joined Elesh Norn's effort to create Atraxa.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who joined Elesh Norn's effort to create Atraxa.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who joined Elesh Norn's effort to create Atraxa.

entities.name: Ikra Shidiqi
entities.description: A naga advisor who betrayed the Sultai's last khan Tasigur to the dragonlord Silumgar and became his first dragonspeaker.

entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: The last khan of the Sultai, betrayed by Ikra Shidiqi.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: The dragonlord who rewarded Ikra's treachery.

entities.name: Reyhan
entities.description: A military commander who refused to kneel to a dragon, became the last khan of the Abzan, and died protecting other khans in the khanfall.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: The dragonlord to whom the Abzan khan surrendered.

entities.name: Ishai
entities.description: The personal attendant of the dragonlord Ojutai, whose word carries his full authority.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: A wise and ancient dragonlord of Tarkir.

entities.name: Breya
entities.description: An Esper artificer who discovered carmot in Jund and replaced most of her body with etherium she created, gaining Jund's wild magic.

entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: A kor line-slinger on Zendikar who left her band after an Eldrazi attack and now protects travelers from Ulamog.

entities.name: Bruse Tarl
entities.description: A Zendikari nomad herder who organized a resistance against the Eldrazi on Akoum and is famed for his insults.

entities.name: Silas Renn
entities.description: The heir of the House of Renn on Esper, a mage among the Seekers of Carmot honored with the first etherium heart.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that Akiri protects travelers from.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane of gods, home to Meletis, Kynaios, Kydele, Thrasios, Tymna and Ravos.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane of Jamuraa and Sidar Kondo.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane of five shards united by the Conflux.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane of clans and dragonlords.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane conquered by Phyrexia.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane ravaged by Eldrazi, home of Akiri and Bruse Tarl.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: The largest polis on Theros, founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire as a beacon of freedom.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: The region of Ludevic's remote laboratory.

entities.name: Selhoff
entities.description: A seaside town terrorized by Kraum.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The homeland of Sidar Kondo on Dominaria.

entities.name: Maelstrom
entities.description: A volatile storm of raw mana at the center of Alara.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: A continent of Zendikar overrun by Eldrazi.

entities.name: Kolaghan clan
entities.description: A goblin clan on Tarkir that Vial Smasher belongs to.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A Tarkir clan that revered ruthlessness.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: A Tarkir clan whose last khan was Reyhan.

entities.name: Battlewise of Meletis
entities.description: An order whose members shape the flow of battle through tactics.

entities.name: Seekers of Carmot
entities.description: An order of mages claiming to know the true nature of etherium.

entities.name: Incurables
entities.description: Grixis mages afflicted with unstable mutations.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The plane-spanning event that united Alara's shards.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: A war on Jamuraa in which Sidar Kondo led.

entities.name: Khanfall
entities.description: The last battle against the dragons on Tarkir.

entities.name: Phyrexian compleation
entities.description: The blessed gift of Phyrexian transformation given to Atraxa.

entities.name: Etherium
entities.description: An aether-infused alloy that Esper uses to augment living things.

entities.name: Carmot
entities.description: A red stone found on Jund needed to create etherium.

events.summary: Kynaios and Tiro rise together to challenge the tyrant Agnomakhos and rally the people.
events.quote: Kynaios and Tiro, joined by their love for one another and for freedom, rose to challenge him.

events.summary: Meletis is founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire with Kynaios and Tiro as guardians.
events.quote: The polis of Meletis was founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire as a beacon of freedom and enlightenment

events.summary: Ludevic becomes the most prolific builder of monsters from animated dead tissue in Nephalia.
events.quote: From his remote laboratory in Nephalia, Ludevic has established himself as the most prolific practitioner of a terrifying tradition

events.summary: Ludevic spends nearly a decade trying to replicate Kraum, which terrorizes Selhoff.
events.quote: Since creating Kraum, the necro-alchemist Ludevic has spent almost a decade trying to replicate that singular work of genius.

events.summary: Sidar Kondo is killed by his own son Vuel, consumed by envy.
events.quote: Kondo died by his own son's hands.

events.summary: Knights from Bant drive Yidris into the Maelstrom, which stabilizes his mutations.
events.quote: Knights from Bant drove Yidris into the Maelstrom, a volatile storm of raw mana at the plane's center.

events.summary: Kruphix reveals to Kydele the nature of the gods and Theros's place in the Multiverse.
events.quote: Kruphix himself revealed to Kydele the true nature of the gods and Theros's place in the Multiverse, a sight she can never unsee.

events.summary: Thrasios leaves Meletis on a pilgrimage to explore the ocean's depths.
events.quote: Thrasios has left his home and embarked on a pilgrimage to explore the ocean's depths at the edge of the world.

events.summary: Vial Smasher spends a lifetime handling and smashing vials of dragonfire in the Kolaghan clan.
events.quote: she has spent a lifetime handling—and smashing—vials of this dangerous substance

events.summary: Saskia survives a massacre, builds a stone monument alone for years, then leads thousands to war on her enemies.
events.quote: Saskia was the sole survivor of a massacre conducted against her village by an invading army from across the sea.

events.summary: A chariot accident blinds Tymna and ends her career among the Battlewise of Meletis.
events.quote: A career filled with victories was cut short by a chariot accident, leaving her blind.

events.summary: Ravos strikes a deal with Athreos to guide the dead in exchange for yearly visits with his lover.
events.quote: Ravos swore to help Athreos guide the dead to the Underworld in exchange for seeing his dead lover once each year.

events.summary: Saprolings take in the abandoned child Tana and she grows into a feral hunter.
events.quote: a pod of fungal saprolings took her in and protected her from the wild

events.summary: Atraxa, a captured Mirran angel, is compleated by Elesh Norn and the other praetors except Urabrask.
events.quote: The praetor Elesh Norn honored the angel's tenacity with the blessed gift of Phyrexian compleation

events.summary: Ikra Shidiqi betrays the Sultai khan Tasigur to the dragonlord Silumgar and becomes his dragonspeaker.
events.quote: Ikra Shidiqi, his naga advisor, betrayed him to the dragonlord Silumgar.

events.summary: Reyhan refuses to kneel to the dragon Dromoka, rallies the Abzan as their final khan, and dies in the khanfall.
events.quote: Reyhan refused to kneel to a dragon.

events.summary: Ishai gains autonomy and authority as Ojutai's attendant.
events.quote: Ishai's word carries the full authority of Ojutai

events.summary: Breya discovers carmot in Jund and replaces most of her body with etherium she created herself.
events.quote: To prove her achievement, Breya replaced the majority of her organic body with etherium she created herself.

events.summary: Akiri leaves her kor band after an Eldrazi attack kills her comrades.
events.quote: she struck out on her own when an Eldrazi attack killed her comrades

events.summary: Bruse Tarl organizes a nomad resistance against the Eldrazi on Akoum.
events.quote: Bruse organized a resistance force of nomads.

events.summary: Silas Renn rises in the Seekers of Carmot and receives the first etherium heart.
events.quote: he was honored with the first etherium heart ever produced
